author: (Kiener, 1839)

note.en: A small turrid collected at Manzanillo in 1999 to 2001 and at Limón in 1945. Slender and pale, it hides in sand and rubble and is rarely noticed.
note.es: Un turrido pequeño recolectado en Manzanillo en 1999 a 2001 y en Limón en 1945. Esbelto y pálido, se esconde en arena y escombro y rara vez se nota.

evidence: WoRMS lists the Costa Rican part of the Caribbean Sea

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)
